about: What every age the 2026 squads WILL carry stands on, and each man's value rating (first written by the Round 1102 bake; carried into Round 1214 from that bake's output, with the value rating added from src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts as main ships it, where every rating IS the value rating). One club a line, the men in the order the squads file ships them (a club with no man has no line). Each man is [the age the value table gave, the table row's year, the table row's id, how his age on 1 August 2026 is resolved (born, moved or written; a man with no table row, unknown, may not ship), for born the birth date, and LAST, always, his value rating]. NOTHING SHIPPED READS THIS FILE YET and the squads file still ships the table's ages: the bake (scripts/bakeClubManagerRosters.mjs) takes over writing this file, on every bake and never by hand, in the round that re-rates the 2026 files, and must then write these lines again for an unchanged table. UNTIL THAT ROUND scripts/genCmAgesBasis2026.mjs writes this file, never a hand: a round that moves, adds, drops or re-orders a 2026 squad man, or that adds a birth date to a ledger, runs it and commits what it writes (it carries each man's table row to where he is now and resolves every line again). No line is written today: the four hand written table rows that stood on the age as written were given birth dates by the fix pass of Round 1214. src/test/cmValueCurve.test.ts holds every line to the rule in scripts/lib/cmAges.mjs, to the three birth date ledgers and to the squads file man for man.
